target_customer: Pharma and biotech buyers and licensors of early drug assets; the company also intends to own and sell assets itself
problem: Overlooked preclinical drug candidates are hard to find and evaluate cheaply; incumbents spend heavily on sourcing and diligence.
business_model: AI-driven asset sourcing and evaluation, currently licensing platform components and running pilots, with a long-term plan to buy, develop and sell drug assets
product_category: AI drug asset discovery and evaluation

founders.name: Ayaan Parikh
education: Stanford, computer science and bio (per YC page)
previous_startups: Three earlier healthtech startups with the co-founder (telemedicine, addiction recovery, hydroponics), per YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page also cites four papers on molecular dynamics and biotech VC and consulting experience

founders.name: Rahul Vijayan
education: Stanford, computer science and economics (per YC page)
previous_startups: Three earlier healthtech startups with the co-founder, per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent pipeline over public models such as AlphaFold, ESM-3 and Boltz-2 is feasible for a small team; real drug validation needs PhD review and partners, and the company says it runs no wet lab.

defensibility.rationale: Built on public models and databases, so the sourcing workflow is copyable; any edge would come from proprietary evaluation data and pharma relationships, none shown yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying it as of November 2026.

market_need_then: Asset sourcing and diligence is costly for pharma, and in silico tools matured in 2024 and 2025; no dated demand data was found for this specific wedge.

identity.voice_and_tone: Founders use the phrase AI-maximalist pharma company

brand_strength.rationale: No source in searches explained the name or showed brand coverage; brand not assessable beyond the website. The name resembles Convex, an unrelated developer platform, in search results.

outcome_analysis: Convexia is an active Summer 2025 company with a four person team and a small, unverified raise. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reports were found in November 2026. Its outcome is undetermined; the plan to run the whole drug lifecycle is capital intensive, and the current business is pilots and licensing of a platform built on public models.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (FundedIQ, VCBacked) show about 500K pre-seed in Sep 2025, Caplight shows 1M total; healthcarediscovery.ai lists YC, Rebel Fund, Gaingels, Gravity Fund, Maiora Ventures and Panacea Capital. No primary source, so no round recorded. No dated competitor found in searches. The launch post describes exits of three startups; the YC page says one was recently acquired, not verified. Update: the 500K pre-seed dated 2025-09 is recorded from VCBacked (FundedIQ agrees; standout.work labels it seed). Single-database basis. Gaingels was not confirmed by search.
